product.name: COOLMAX® Slim Fit Polo Shirt
product.description: Slim-fit polo shirt in lightweight cotton-blend pique that hugs contours of the body for a fitted silhouette. Collar, button placket, and short sleeves. Made with COOLMAX® functional fabric – a unique, soft, comfortable, and fast-drying polyester fiber to efficiently wick moisture while regulating temperature.
